description: గిరిజన బాంధవుడు కేసీఆర్‌ అని మాజీ మంత్రి సత్యవతి రాథోడ్‌ కొనియాడారు. తెలంగాణ తొలి ముఖ్యమంత్రి కేసీఆర్‌ గిరిజన రిజర్వేషన్‌ పెంపు అమల్లోకి వచ్చి నాలుగేండ్లు పూర్తవుతున్న సందర్భాన్ని గుర్తుచేసుకుంటూ బుధవారం ఆమె మహబూబాబాద్‌లో మీడియాతో మాట్లాడుతూ కేసీఆర్‌కు కృతజ్ఞతలు తెలిపారు. ఈ సందర్భంగా ఆమె మాట్లాడుతూ.. గత పదేండ్ల కేసీఆర్‌ పాలనలో గిరిజనుల అభివృద్ధి, సంక్షే మం కోసం ఎన్నో కీలక నిర్ణయాలు తీసుకున్నారని తెలిపారు.

title: US stocks: Nasdaq rises while S&P, Dow dip as softer inflation cools Fed hike bets
description: On Wednesday, inflation data led to mixed market movements, with the Nasdaq increasing slightly. The Dow and S&P 500 faced declines, although both indexes posted quarterly gains. Private employers added 90,000 jobs in September, contributing to labor market reports this week. The S&P 500 achieved new highs while also experiencing several lows in its performance. Rising concerns about inflation continue to influence economic outlooks and Federal Reserve expectations.

title: France’s 10-year bond yield heads for biggest quarterly surge since 1987
description: France's bond yields have been rising sharply, with September seeing the largest increase in decades. Investors are concerned about inflation as energy costs continue to rise, impacting fiscal stability. The government plans to issue €340 billion in bonds next year, which could strain its fiscal position further. Economic indicators suggest that pressures on interest rates may remain elevated going forward.

title: Polymarket introduces deposit limits, lock-outs to combat trading addiction
description: Polymarket has introduced innovative tools aimed at aiding users in controlling excessive trading habits. These features include optional deposit restrictions, self-imposed lock-outs, and connections to mental health support. Users can customize lock-out periods and limit deposits based on their needs. The startup collaborates with Birches Health to offer resources for users seeking help. Moreover, Polymarket has founded a Trust & Safety Centre to clarify its commitment to user security.

title: Indian rupee rebounds to 95.83 vs US dollar as crude prices ease
description: The rupee strengthened 0.16% to 95.83 against the dollar, recovering from morning weakness as crude prices eased below $103 a barrel. Dollar selling by public sector banks and broader Asian currency gains also supported the recovery despite foreign investor outflows.

title: US SEC proposes wider retail investor access to private assets amid risk concerns
description: The SEC has proposed new rules to expand access to private assets typically available only to wealthy investors. These rules aim to allow more professionals to qualify as accredited investors, which may lead to higher returns. Critics express concern that this move could expose retail investors to significant risks and fees. Additionally, proposed changes would allow closed-end funds to redeem shares more frequently and offer varied share classes.

title: ElevenLabs' valuation doubles to $22 billion on surging AI voice-agent demand
description: ElevenLabs has successfully finalised a notable employee tender offer, achieving a staggering valuation of $22 billion this week. This impressive growth reflects a significant bump from its prior funding round back in February. Noteworthy investors such as Wellington, T. Rowe Price, and Andreessen Horowitz participated. The firm’s voice technology facilitates over 15 million conversations weekly across diverse applications.

title: US crude oil output rose in July, while petroleum demand declined, EIA says
description: In July, US crude oil production climbed to 13.95 million barrels per day, up from June’s figures. Despite the production surge, the demand for crude oil and petroleum products dropped to 20.61 million barrels per day. Meanwhile, gross natural gas production reached a remarkable 137.0 billion cubic feet per day, with Texas's output increasing to 40.1 billion cubic feet per day, contrasting slightly with a decline in Pennsylvania.

title: US stocks: AI infra firm Accelevation valued at $3.9 billion as shares fall in Nasdaq debut
description: Accelevation's shares began trading below the initial public offering price of $18, reflecting current market instability. The company, which focuses on data center infrastructure, successfully raised $540 million by offering around 30 million shares at a debut price of $17.55. Founded in 2017, Accelevation achieved impressive revenue growth, totaling $447.8 million by 2025 amidst an uncertain U.S. IPO landscape that is impacting this listing season.
